title: Motie van het lid Beckerman over een bevoegde instantie aanwijzen om ook deepfakeporno en andere onrechtmatige seksuele beelden offline te halen

reading.body:
Generative AI technology was used to create non-consensual sexualized deepfake videos of Dutch public figures, including entertainers, athletes, government officials, and members of the Royal Family, and distribute them on a platform with millions of monthly visitors. The failure was a deployment without meaningful access controls, allowing the technology to be weaponized for impersonation and harassment at scale. Catching it would have required either preventing the upload of synthetic sexual content through detection systems, or requiring human review of flagged material before publication.

The deployment exposed a gap between technical capability and legal framework. Dutch law treats deepfake pornography as prosecutable under revenge porn statutes, but the case shows that legal recourse occurs only after harm is already widespread. No facts establish whether the platform operators knew deepfakes were being created, whether detection systems existed, or what preventive measures had been considered before the videos circulated.

summary:
Multiple Dutch female celebrities are considering legal action after discovering themselves in manipulated pornographic videos posted on an online platform that receives 13 million monthly visitors. The videos feature Dutch entertainers, television presenters, Olympic athletes, current and former government ministers, mayors, and members of the Royal Family. The interim justice minister called the videos disgusting and urged victims to file reports. Several managers and representatives confirmed to the news organization that their clients have filed complaints or are exploring legal options.

Deepfake pornography, which digitally places a person's face onto adult performers, falls under revenge porn laws and is therefore prosecutable. Lawyers advise victims to file reports, after which authorities may attempt to shut down the website. Alternative options include launching a mass claim, filing a complaint with the data protection authority, or contacting hosting companies. A previous case involved television presenter Welmoed Sijtsma, whose alleged attacker received a conditional sentence of 180 hours of community service in November.
title_en: Motion by member Beckerman on designating a competent authority to also remove deepfake pornography and other unlawful sexual images offline
